data.fund_name: Tata Nifty Financial Services Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking Nifty Financial Services Index.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns, before expenses, that commensurate with the performance ofNifty Financial Services Index (TRI), subject to tracking error. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objectiveof the scheme will be achieved. The scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
data.asset_allocation: Securities covered by Nifty Financial Services Index (95-100),Debt & Money Market Instruments including units of MutualFunds (0-5).
data.exit_load: 0.25% of the applicable NAV, if redeemed on or before 15 days from the date of allotment.
